_comment: Insurgency Protocol: The Fifth Column. Edit freely -- setup_discord.py is idempotent, so you can add entries and re-run it without duplicating anything. Nothing is ever deleted.

channels.name: welcome
channels.topic: Start here. Read the protocol, claim a role, report for assignment.

channels.name: rules-of-engagement
channels.topic: Conduct expected of every operative. Violations answer to Command.

channels.name: announcements
channels.topic: Official transmissions from Command. Low traffic, high signal.

channels.name: roster
channels.topic: Active operatives, callsigns, and current assignments.

channels.name: ops-planning
channels.topic: Working channel for planning active operations.

channels.name: after-action
channels.topic: AARs. What worked, what broke, what changes next time.

channels.name: bot-feed
channels.topic: Automated posts. Webhook target -- humans need not post here.

channels.name: general
channels.topic: Open channel. Anything goes within the rules of engagement.

channels.name: recruiting
channels.topic: Invite links, outreach, and prospect discussion.

channels.name: command
channels.topic: Command and Handler coordination. Not visible to the rank and file.

channels.name: handler-notes
channels.topic: Running notes on operatives, plot threads, and pending reveals.

channels.name: moderation-log
channels.topic: Record of moderation actions and their justification.
